labels.name: Upper trunk
labels.function: Formed by C5-C6; injury causes Erb-Duchenne palsy

labels.name: Middle trunk
labels.function: Continuation of the C7 root by itself

labels.name: Lower trunk
labels.function: Formed by the C8 and T1 roots

labels.name: Lateral cord
labels.function: Formed by anterior divisions of the C5-C7 trunks

labels.name: Posterior cord
labels.function: Union of all three posterior divisions

labels.name: Medial cord
labels.function: Formed by the anterior division of the C8-T1 trunk

labels.name: Musculocutaneous nerve
labels.function: Anterior arm compartment (elbow flexors); lateral forearm skin

labels.name: Axillary nerve
labels.function: Deltoid and teres minor; at risk in surgical neck fracture

labels.name: Radial nerve
labels.function: Posterior arm and forearm; midshaft fracture causes wrist drop

labels.name: Median nerve
labels.function: Most anterior forearm muscles and selected hand muscles

labels.name: Ulnar nerve
labels.function: Selected forearm muscles and many intrinsic hand muscles

labels.name: Supraspinatus
labels.function: Initiates abduction (first ~15 degrees); tendon most often torn

labels.name: Infraspinatus
labels.function: Lateral rotation; nerve passes through the scapular notch

labels.name: Teres minor
labels.function: Lateral rotation; shares its nerve with the deltoid

labels.name: Teres major
labels.function: Extends, adducts, medially rotates; lower subscapular nerve

labels.name: Long head of triceps brachii
labels.function: Arises from infraglenoid tubercle; extends and adducts the arm

labels.name: Spine of scapula
labels.function: Bony ridge dividing the upper and lower posterior fossae

labels.name: Acromion
labels.function: Articulates with the clavicle; roof over the cuff tendon

labels.name: Axillary nerve
labels.function: Passes the quadrangular space; at risk in surgical neck fracture

labels.name: Radial nerve
labels.function: Exits the triangular interval; at risk in midshaft fracture

labels.name: Biceps brachii
labels.function: Flexes elbow and is a powerful supinator of the forearm

labels.name: Brachialis
labels.function: Pure, primary elbow flexor acting on the ulna

labels.name: Triceps brachii
labels.function: Primary elbow extensor; inserts on the olecranon

labels.name: Humerus
labels.function: Single long bone of the arm

labels.name: Musculocutaneous nerve
labels.function: Supplies every anterior compartment muscle of the arm

labels.name: Median nerve
labels.function: Most anterior forearm muscles and selected hand muscles

labels.name: Brachial artery
labels.function: Primary arterial supply of the arm; palpable pulse point

labels.name: Ulnar nerve
labels.function: Selected forearm muscles and many intrinsic hand muscles

labels.name: Radial nerve
labels.function: Supplies the posterior compartment; injury causes wrist drop

labels.name: Deep brachial artery
labels.function: Largest branch of the arm's main artery; posterior compartment
